items.title: Chick Corea — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The guys were 15-20 years younger than me... John Patitucci and Dave Weckl—within the group formed a trio... That’s how the Elecktric Band got started. But John came along and just covered the whole...

ctx.x: Did this group also generate new ideas for writing for you?

It did. The Elektric Band was more... It remained more my band as a composer. The guys were 15-20 years younger than me, and happy to play my music. And I was happy to write for it. Whereas Return to Forever became more of a cooperative band where everybody was writing music. So that’s kind of the direction that I think the Elektric Band took. We recorded 5 or 6 or 7 records, and it was always a new repertoire, and then we always took it out and played. The other nice thing about the Elektric Band that I really…

There are two things I want to make a point of addressing. One is that you mentioned, again in these earlier conversations, that you began to rekindle your interest in classical music in a serious way, specifically the music of Mozart, at some point in the ‘70s or the early ‘80s, and that this is one interest that starts to animate you during those years. Can you talk about how that happened? I think you mentioned that you’d heard classical music, you’d played, it wasn’t something you took particularly seriously,…
